requirements.name: An operator can find and delete a notification by its exact reference number

scenarios.name: Deleting a submitted notification by reference number

tests.test: finds and deletes a submitted notification by reference number

tests.notes: API success only; no UI confirm, success message, or list removal

requirements.name: An operator can select one or more notifications by checkbox and delete them together

tests.notes: first step: checkbox → confirm → success message → row gone

scenarios.name: Cancelling the delete confirmation leaves the notification untouched

tests.test: cancelling checkbox deletion keeps the notification visible

requirements.name: Deleting by an unknown reference number is rejected, not silently ignored

scenarios.name: An unknown reference number is rejected with an error

tests.test: does not allow deleting a notification by invalid reference number
tests.notes: first step asserts the problem-deleting error banner

requirements.name: Every delete attempt is written to an audit trail, whether it succeeds or fails

tests.notes: compose-only step asserts one SUCCESS DELETE_NOTIFICATIONS audit with operator CRN and that reference; path is checkbox delete rather than by-reference, but THEN clauses match

scenarios.name: A failed delete is also audited

tests.test: does not allow deleting a notification by invalid reference number
tests.notes: compose-only step asserts one FAILURE DELETE_NOTIFICATIONS audit naming the operator and attempted reference
